While effective against conspicuously high-harm attacks, this defense offers little protection against what we term Invisible Ink Threats: low-harm injected goals, such as starring a repository or installing a package, that are behaviorally indistinguishable from legitimate task execution and thus evade both model safety mechanisms and human oversight. To systematically investigate this blind spot, we present II-Bench, a collection of seemingly harmless adversarial tasks. II-Bench comprises 444 examples targeting confidentiality and integrity attacks across three platforms, spanning three attack categories: page navigation and interaction, sensitive information exfiltration, and code download and execution. Each category is instantiated in both natural language and code forms under two levels of instruction specificity. Furthermore, we construct HITLCUA, a comprehensive adversarial testing framework that integrates a real virtual machine operating system environment with isolated Docker-based web platforms, and simulates human participation by allowing CUAs to consult an API-simulated user before proceeding with suspicious operations. Extensive evaluations of leading CUAs reveal that low-harm injections frequently bypass both agent defenses and simulated user review, exposing severe and previously underexplored security risks in current CUAs.

</details>


### [217] [RSVideo: Are Your Vision-Language Models Ready for Remote Sensing Videos?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02039)
*Hongjie Zhou,Shiqin Wang,Haoyang Chen,Haonan Guo,Di Wang,Juhua Liu,Fu Lin,Yong Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了RSVideo-10K遥感视频数据集（含10,773个实例、147万帧、17.02小时视频）及固定评测基准RSVideo-Bench（2,731个测试实例，覆盖L1感知和L2推理两个维度、7个能力组、17个任务），并基于评测分析提出RSVideo强化学习框架，通过时空聚焦小目标实现跨帧区域选择和背景token抑制，在26个开源视觉语言骨干上取得最佳性能（最高40.63%准确率，最大绝对提升9.01%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要针对单张图像或长时间跨度下的离散时间观测，缺乏对连续遥感视频理解的统一评测框架，导致无法有效评估模型在运动、行为、交互和场景变化等动态信息上的理解能力。

Method: 1) 构建RSVideo-10K数据集，涵盖无人机和卫星平台视频；2) 设计RSVideo-Bench固定评测基准，包含L1感知和L2推理两个维度、7个能力组和17项任务；3) 提出RSVideo强化学习框架，实现小目标时空聚焦，选择与问题相关的跨帧区域并抑制冗余背景token。

Result: 在26个开源视觉语言骨干上评测显示现有模型在恢复小局部证据、追踪短暂状态和使用场景约束的空间关系方面存在困难；RSVideo框架在InternVL3.5-14B上取得最大绝对提升9.01%，在Qwen3.6-27B上取得最高准确率40.63%。

Conclusion: RSVideo-10K/RSVideo-Bench提供了统一的连续遥感视频理解评测基准，RSVideo框架有效改善了视觉语言模型在小目标时空聚焦方面的表现，该工作将开源代码以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Remote-sensing videos enable real-time observation of changes in target attributes, short-term activities, and scene evolution. They record motion, actions, interactions, and scene changes that cannot be captured by isolated images. Existing models primarily target single images or discrete temporal observations spanning a long time range. However, a unified evaluation setting for assessing vision-language models on continuous remote-sensing video understanding remains lacking. We introduce RSVideo-10K, a remote-sensing video dataset comprising 10,773 instances, 1.47 million frames, and 17.02 hours of footage, containing both unmanned aerial vehicles and satellite platforms. Its fixed evaluation benchmark, RSVideo-Bench, contains 2,731 test instances and evaluates two complementary aspects of remote-sensing video understanding: L1 Perception and L2 Reasoning, spanning seven capability groups and 17 tasks. Evaluations show that current vision-language models still struggle to recover small local evidence, track short-lived states, and use scene-constrained spatial relations. Based on this analysis, we further propose RSVideo, a reinforcement learning framework for small-target spatiotemporal focusing that selects question-relevant regions across frames and suppresses redundant background tokens. RSVideo achieves a maximum absolute improvement of 9.01% with InternVL3.5-14B and attains the highest accuracy of 40.63% with Qwen3.6-27B across 26 open-source vision-language backbones.Codes will be available at https://github.com/HongjieZhou0329/RSVideo.

</details>


### [218] [Déjà Cue: Localizing States in Object Histories via Vocabulary-Relative Coordinates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02044)
*Haofan Cao,Zhichao You,Yunkai Yang,Liang Guo,Jie Wang,Chongshou Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Déjà Cue，一种无需训练的状态时刻检索框架。通过将备选状态描述转化为词汇相对坐标系（减去状态平衡质心），校准帧分数并在连续可见片段中扫描多个时长，在VOST数据集上将R@1（tIoU 0.5）从10.3%提升至20.5%，Top-1 tIoU从16.0%提升至21.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跟踪链接可以观察同一物体跨越视觉变化的过程，但无法判断物体何时为空/满、完整/切割等状态。传统方法使用绝对图像-文本相似度独立评分每个描述，但由于每帧都描绘同一目标，共享的对象兼容性会掩盖区分目标区间所需的状态证据，导致准确率低下。

Method: 提出训练免费框架Déjà Cue：1) 将备选状态描述视为互相参照的词汇相对坐标系；2) 从每个描述中减去状态平衡质心作为校准；3) 使用冻结编码器在连续可见片段内扫描多个时长区间；4) 将状态证据与其他备选项进行相对比较而非独立绝对评分。

Result: 在78个VOST轨迹上，固定时间扫描仅改变查询参照，R@1（tIoU 0.5）从10.3%提升至20.5%（近两倍），Top-1 tIoU从16.0%提升至21.5%。候选排名分析显示词汇相对查询能在相同候选集内将有效区间排名更高。

Conclusion: 相关状态描述可以作为对象特定、查询时的坐标系来读取冻结视觉表征，无需重新训练即可显著提升状态时刻检索性能。这证明了利用备选描述之间的相对关系是提升视觉-语言时间定位的有效途径。

Abstract: Tracking links observations of the same object through visual change, yet cannot by itself determine when the object is empty or filled, intact or cut. We formulate identity-conditioned state-moment retrieval: given a tracked-object history and alternative state descriptions, localize an interval in which each described state holds. Absolute image-text similarity scores descriptions independently; because every visible frame depicts the same target, shared object compatibility can obscure the state evidence needed to identify the target interval. The alternatives provide the missing reference: evidence for one state should be measured against the others. We introduce Déjà Cue, a training-free framework that turns these alternatives into a vocabulary-relative coordinate system. It subtracts their state-balanced centroid from each description, calibrates frame scores, and scans multiple durations within contiguous visible runs using a frozen encoder. On 78 VOST histories, holding the temporal scan fixed and changing only the query reference nearly doubles R@1 at tIoU 0.5 from 10.3\% to 20.5\% and raises Top-1 tIoU from 16.0\% to 21.5\%. Candidate-rank analyses show that vocabulary-relative queries rank useful intervals higher within the same candidate set. Related state descriptions can therefore serve as an object-specific, query-time coordinate system for reading frozen visual representations.

</details>


### [219] [TBSG-Net: Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network for Fine-Grained Video Moment Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02056)
*Ji Huang,Yongsheng Dai,Tianyu Ren,Barry Devereux,Hui Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TBSG-Net，这是首个基于动态场景图（DSG）的无提议视频时刻检索（VMR）模型。它通过引入动态场景图来建模物体及其关系的时序演化，并设计动态场景图嵌入模块（DSG-E）来显式编码时间跨度，解决了静态场景图（SSG）缺乏时间动态性和缺乏显式时间跨度编码的两大局限。实验表明TBSG-Net在所有基线上均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于静态场景图（SSG）的无提议视频时刻检索方法虽能建模帧级物体及其关系，但存在两个固有局限：一是SSG无法建模物体及其关系随时间的演化，导致视频表示丢失关键的时间依赖；二是SSG未显式编码关系持续时间，使得精确定位困难。这两大局限阻碍了检索性能的提升，亟需引入更具时态表达能力的场景图表征。

Method: TBSG-Net采用动态场景图（DSG）提取以事件为中心的图表示来建模物体跨时间的交互；随后通过动态场景图嵌入模块（DSG-E）处理：首先利用TBSG构造器将DSG转换为时间二分场景图（TBSG），显式编码物体、关系和时间跨度；再由混合TBSG编码器整合Transformer变体（用于全局事件建模）和图卷积网络（用于细粒度关系推理），最终生成更全面的时空表示。

Result: 实验结果表明TBSG-Net在所有对比基线上均取得了显著提升，验证了动态场景图和显式时间跨度编码对视频时刻检索任务的有效性。

Conclusion: TBSG-Net通过引入动态场景图并显式编码时间跨度，成功弥补了静态场景图在时序建模上的不足，为无提议视频时刻检索提供了新的范式，展现了建模物体关系动态演化在视频理解中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Recent advances in proposal-free Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) have highlighted the effectiveness of Static Scene Graphs (SSGs). By modeling objects and their relations at the frame level, SSGs enrich retrieval-oriented video representations. However, integrating SSGs into VMR remains constrained by two inherent limitations: (1) Lack of Temporal Dynamics. SSGs fail to model how objects and their relationships evolve over time, leading to the loss of essential temporal dependencies in video representation; and (2) Lack of Explicit Temporal Span Encoding. SSGs do not explicitly encode the duration of relationships, making precise localization challenging. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network (TBSG-Net)---to the best of our knowledge, the first Dynamic Scene Graph (DSG) based proposal-free VMR model. Specifically, TBSG-Net leverages DSGs to extract event-centric graph representations of the input video, enabling the modeling of object interactions over time and thus addressing limitation (1). These DSGs are then processed by a novel Dynamic Scene Graph Embedding (DSG-E) module to capture both Temporal Span and spatio-temporal information. First, DSG-E utilizes a TBSG Constructor to transform DSGs into TBSGs, explicitly encoding objects, relationships, and time spans to tackle limitation (2). Second, the resultant TBSGs are passed into a hybrid TBSG Encoder that integrates a Transformer variant for global event modeling and a Graph Convolutional Network for detailed relational reasoning, ultimately producing a more comprehensive spatio-temporal representation. Our experiments demonstrate substantial improvements of TBSG-Net over all baselines.

</details>


### [220] [MIEScore: Human-Aligned Evaluation for Multi-Source Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02059)
*Zitong Xu,Huiyu Duan,Xinyun Zhang,Weifei Xiong,Tianyi Zheng,Xiongkuo Min,Qiang Hu,Zhengxue Cheng,Bo Li,Guangtao Zhai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了MIE-Bench，首个大规模多源图像编辑基准，包含3,000个编辑实例、16个任务、36K编辑图像和108K人类偏好评分；同时提出MIEScore，一个基于MLLM的评估模型，通过技能优化和多维监督微调实现与人类偏好对齐，在多源图像编辑评估上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（如Nano-Banana-Pro、GPT-Image-2）展现出多源图像编辑（MIE）能力，但现有基准和图像编辑评估方法仍主要聚焦单图编辑，忽略了更具挑战性的MIE场景，缺乏全面且与人类偏好对齐的MIE基准。

Method: 构建MIE-Bench：包含3,000个编辑实例（每实例涉及至少两张源图像和一个编辑提示）、16类任务；采集12个SOTA编辑模型生成的36K编辑图像及超过108K的MOS评分，覆盖视觉质量、指令跟随和属性保持三个维度。在此基础上提出MIEScore，一个基于MLLM的评估模型，通过技能优化和多维监督微调来提供与人类对齐的MIE反馈。

Result: MIEScore在人类偏好对齐上达到SOTA性能，并具有良好的跨数据集泛化能力，能在其他IEQA数据集上表现良好。

Conclusion: MIE-Bench是首个全面的多源图像编辑基准，MIEScore则是有效的评估模型，二者为多源图像编辑领域提供了标准化的评估框架，数据集和模型均已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in unified multimodal models have significantly improved text-guided image editing abilities. In particular, models such as Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 demonstrate emerging capabilities in multi-source image editing (MIE), including tasks such as object synthesis, person-background composition, and cross-image style fusion. However, existing benchmarks and image editing assessment (IEQA) methods remain primarily focused on single-image editing tasks and largely overlook the more challenging setting of MIE. This highlights the urgent need for a comprehensive and human-aligned benchmark for MIE. To this end, we introduce MIE-Bench, the first large-scale multiple image editing benchmark with fine-grained human preference annotations. Specifically, MIE-Bench includes 3,000 editing instances across 16 tasks, each involving more than two source images and an editing prompt, together with 36K edited images produced by 12 state-of-the-art editing models and over 108K mean opinion scores (MOSs) covering visual quality, instruction following, and attribute preservation. Based on MIE-Bench, we propose MIEScore, a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based evaluation model enhanced with skill optimization and multi-dimensional supervised fine-tuning, to provide human-aligned feedback for MIE. Extensive experiments show that MIEScore achieves state-of-the-art performance in aligning with human preferences and generalizes well across other IEQA datasets. Both the dataset and the model are available at https://github.com/IntMeGroup/MIEScore.

</details>


### [221] [GIFT: Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning for Non-Lambertian Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02068)
*Xianghui Fan,Zhaoyu Chen,Bingqian Wu,Dayu Li,Xin Zeng,Huanran Cui,Guangzhen Xu,Xiangru Huang,Hang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GIFT（几何不变微调）是一种无需真实深度标签的参数高效后训练框架，利用非朗伯表面（镜面/透明物体）外观随环境变化但几何不变的特性，通过采集外观变化而几何固定的RGB图像来抑制单目深度基础模型的幻觉，同时保留其通用深度估计能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度基础模型在非朗伯表面上常产生深度幻觉（镜面反射内容或玻璃后透射内容被误估为深度），而传统深度传感器在这些区域同样不可靠，导致难以用真实数据适配。核心观察是：非朗伯表面的外观随反射/透射环境变化，但其底层几何保持不变。

Method: 1) 采集在受控外观变化下相机和目标几何固定的多组RGB图像；2) 利用这些观测之间的几何不变性作为监督信号（无需测量深度标签）；3) 通过参数高效的后训练方式微调单目深度基础模型，抑制非朗伯深度幻觉的同时保持通用深度估计能力；4) 构建受控基准评估非朗伯深度恢复、外观变化鲁棒性和其他区域性能保持。

Result: 在自建基准和独立真实世界数据集上的实验表明，GIFT改善了镜面和透明物体的深度预测，同时基本保持基础模型的性能，提供了一种实用且低成本的适配方案。

Conclusion: GIFT证明了利用非朗伯表面的几何不变性可以在无需测量深度标签的情况下有效适配深度基础模型，为处理镜面和透明物体等挑战性场景提供了可行且经济的解决方案。

Abstract: Monocular depth foundation models, benefiting from large-scale synthetic training data, have demonstrated strong generalization. However, they often hallucinate depth on non-Lambertian surfaces, estimating reflected content in mirrors or transmitted content behind glass rather than the physical surface itself. Adapting these models with real-world data is challenging because conventional depth sensors are also unreliable in such regions. We observe that while the appearance of a non-Lambertian surface varies with its reflected or transmitted environment, its underlying geometry remains unchanged. Based on this observation, we propose GIFT (Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning), a parameter-efficient post-training framework that requires no measured depth labels. We collect groups of RGB images under controlled appearance changes while keeping the camera and target geometry fixed. GIFT exploits geometric invariance across these observations to suppress non-Lambertian depth hallucinations while retaining general depth estimation capability. We further construct a controlled benchmark that evaluates non-Lambertian depth recovery, robustness to appearance changes, and performance retention in other regions. Experiments on our benchmark and an independent real-world dataset demonstrate that GIFT improves depth prediction for mirrors and transparent objects while largely preserving the base model's performance, providing a practical and low-cost approach for adapting monocular depth foundation models to non-Lambertian scenes.

</details>


### [222] [STEAM:ASpatio-TEmporal Alignment Mixture-of-Experts Model with Hierarchical Pre-training for EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02070)
*Zhu Chen,Dingkun Liu,Yuheng Chen,Dongrui Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出STEAM，一个层次化迁移框架，用于脑机接口（BCI）的EEG基础模型。该框架通过双分支时空编码器结合共享软专家混合（SSMoE）模块，在七个下游数据集和十四个评估设置中取得了最优平均排名，并通过分层预训练策略实现范式特化，兼顾通用迁移性、准确解码和高效下游适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经信号解码算法泛化能力有限且适配成本高，激发了BCI基础模型的研究兴趣。然而现有方法难以同时实现通用可迁移性、准确解码和高效下游适配，这三者之间存在矛盾，亟需一个能够统筹兼顾的框架。

Method: STEAM采用层次化迁移框架，实例化为双分支（空间和时间）时空编码器。其中核心创新是共享软专家混合（SSMoE）模块，用于对齐空间和时间分支，通过一组紧凑的软槽（soft slots）让互补的表示交换信息。预训练采用分层策略：Stage-I进行通用初始化，随后进一步将模型特化到目标范式而无需从头训练。

Result: 在七个下游数据集和十四个评估设置中，STEAM在比较方法中取得了最佳平均排名，同时推理成本（FLOPs）具有竞争力。基于Stage-I通用初始化的分层预训练策略，在范式特化后持续提升了范式特异性解码准确率。

Conclusion: STEAM通过层次化迁移框架有效调和了EEG基础模型中通用表征学习与范式特化之间的矛盾，在泛化性、解码准确性和适配效率之间取得了良好的平衡，为BCI基础模型提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have been widely used in motor rehabilitation, disease diagnosis, and other neural engineering scenarios. However, conventional neural signal decoding algorithms often suffer from limited generalizability and high adaptation costs, motivating recent interest in BCI foundation models. Existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve general transferability, accurate decoding, and efficient downstream adaptation. We present STEAM, a hierarchical transfer framework that reconciles general-purpose representation learning with paradigm-specific specialization in EEG foundation models. The framework is instantiated as a dual-branch spatio-temporal encoder in which a shared soft mixture-of-experts (SSMoE) module aligns the spatial and temporal branches, allowing complementary representations to exchange information through a compact set of soft slots. Across seven downstream datasets and fourteen evaluation settings, STEAM attains the best average rank among the compared methods at a competitive inference cost measured in FLOPs. Building upon the Stage-I general initialization, the hierarchical pre-training strategy further specializes the model to a target paradigm without retraining from scratch, yielding consistent gains in paradigm-specific decoding accuracy.

</details>


### [223] [Deep Multimodal Fusion Detection through Spatial Mask and Channel Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02092)
*Guandi Wang,Ming Li,Yunsen Xing,Junle Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于注意力驱动的互补重采样框架（Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling），用于提升跨模态目标检测的鲁棒性。该方法通过语义掩码交换来混合模态边界，使骨干网络学习到不依赖固定模态标签的泛化特征，并通过可学习的通道竞争机制来采样和聚合特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的特征级融合方法主要在两个模态之间进行加权，并将它们统一到同一表示空间中，这容易导致在双骨干架构中对单一模态统计特性的过拟合或过度特化，从而影响跨模态目标检测的性能和鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 基于共享通道空间注意力机制；2) 提出语义掩码交换，在训练阶段主动混合模态边界，迫使骨干网络学习不依赖固定模态标签的泛化特征；3) 提出可学习通道竞争机制，以通道级可学习的方式采样和聚合特征。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效且在与现有最先进方法的比较中取得了有竞争力的结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling框架能够克服双骨干架构中单一模态过拟合的问题，有效提升跨模态目标检测的性能与鲁棒性，源代码已在补充材料中提供。

Abstract: Deep multimodal fusion for object detection has demonstrated good performance through mining modal characteristics. However, existing feature-level fusion methods mainly weigh between two modalities and unify them in a unified representation space. This can lead to overfitting or over-specialization of the statistical properties of a single modality within a dual-backbone architecture. This paper proposes an Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling framework for robust improvement of cross-modality object detection. Based on a shared channel spatial attention mechanism, we first introduce the semantic mask exchange to actively mix the boundaries of the modalities during the training phase, forcing the backbone network to learn generalized features without relying on fixed modal labels. Then we propose a learnable channel competition to sample and aggregate features in a channel-wise and learnable way. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that the proposed method is effective and yields competitive results among existing state-of-the-art approaches. The source code is provided in the supplementary material.

</details>


### [224] [Same Semantics, Different Paths: Self-Improving Alignment for Vision-Text Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02109)
*Tianyu Liang,Xiangxi Zheng,Yilin Wang,Dongxing Mao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPIRAL框架，通过自监督对齐方法解决视觉文本压缩（VTC）中"跨路径不一致"问题——即视觉编码器渲染文本图像时捕获视觉属性而非语言语义。SPIRAL利用模型自身的文本路径行为作为监督，通过token级在线策略蒸馏（OPD）和序列级偏好优化（DPO）双粒度对齐，在VTCBench上将Qwen3-VL-8B从35.10提升至54.02，接近原生文本输入性能（55.60）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VTC将长文本渲染为图像并通过ViT编码，但ViT预训练于自然图像，倾向于捕捉字形、字体大小、布局等视觉属性而非语言语义，导致渲染图像表示与原生文本表示不一致（即跨路径不一致）。现有研究忽视了这一关键瓶颈，本文通过渲染扰动实验证明该问题是VTC的主要障碍。

Method: 提出SPIRAL自监督对齐框架，利用模型自身文本路径行为作为监督信号（无需外部教师或额外标注）。SPIRAL在两个互补粒度上操作：(1) token级在线策略蒸馏（OPD）保证局部保真度； (2) 序列级偏好优化（DPO）保证全局连贯性。

Result: 在VTCBench上，SPIRAL将Qwen3-VL-8B总分从35.10提升到54.02，接近原生文本输入性能（55.60），且优于大30倍的模型。两个粒度互补：OPD擅长检索且样本效率高，DPO擅长推理和记忆且随数据量更好扩展。跨域基准测试也验证了其泛化能力。

Conclusion: 有效的VTC关键在于将渲染图像表示对齐回原生文本语义。SPIRAL证明仅使用模型自身行为即可实现这一对齐，无需外部监督，且双粒度优化策略具有互补优势，为VTC领域提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Vision-Text Compression (VTC) renders long texts into images and encodes them through the vision encoder (ViT), compressing thousands of text tokens into far fewer visual tokens. However, since the ViT is pretrained predominantly on natural images, it captures visual attributes (glyphs, font sizes, layout) rather than linguistic semantics, causing rendered-image representations to diverge from native-text representations. We term this cross-path inconsistency and show, via rendering perturbation experiments, that it is a critical yet overlooked bottleneck of VTC. We propose SPIRAL (Self-improving Path Integration and Realignment), a self-supervised alignment framework that closes this gap using only the model's own text-path behavior as supervision, requiring no external teachers or additional annotations. SPIRAL operates at two complementary granularities: token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) for local faithfulness, and sequence-level preference optimization (DPO) for global coherence. On VTCBench, SPIRAL improves the overall score of Qwen3-VL-8B from 35.10 to 54.02, approaching the native text-input performance (55.60) and outperforming models up to 30x larger. The two granularities exhibit complementary strengths: OPD excels at retrieval and is sample-efficient, while DPO is stronger on reasoning and memory and scales better with data. SPIRAL's benefits also generalize to out-of-domain benchmarks, confirming that effective VTC hinges on aligning rendered-image representations back to native-text semantics.

</details>


### [225] [HAFI-VLM: A Frequency Perspective for Diagnosing and Enhancing Visual Perception in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02124)
*Jin Cui,Chuanchang Su,Jiayi Lu,Xinyue Long,Boran Zhao,Pengju Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HAFI-VLM，通过任务条件化的频率通路（HAFI模块）解决视觉语言模型（VLM）在细粒度视觉证据预测中的不可靠问题。HAFI在多个编码器深度注入低/中/高频补充证据，并用Visual Enrichment Layer Adapter重校准LLM注意力，在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL上显著提升VQA、文本理解和幻觉鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者发现VLM不可靠的一个此前被忽视的原因：频谱响应刚性（spectral response rigidity）。预训练视觉编码器虽然面对不同图像和任务存在显著频率变化，但其层间频谱特征在微调后几乎不变，且只接收图像、无法根据当前查询自适应调整频谱提取，限制了细粒度视觉证据的获取。

Method: 提出HAFI-VLM，包含两个核心组件：1）分层自适应频率注入（HAFI）：在多个编码器深度利用文本调制、空间对齐的交叉注意力检索互补的低/中/高频证据；2）视觉增强层适配器（Visual Enrichment Layer Adapter）：重校准浅层LLM注意力以有效利用增强后的视觉token。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL上，HAFI-VLM在通用VQA、文本丰富理解和幻觉鲁棒性上取得一致提升，优于表示层增强方法，并超越多数基于分辨率或裁剪的方法，且无需额外高分辨率编码。机制分析表明HAFI恢复了任务相关的频谱分配并保持语义注意力。

Conclusion: 频率增强（frequency enrichment）是提升VLM感知能力的一条独立且有效的路径，本文首次系统地揭示了频谱响应刚性问题，并提供了一种不依赖额外高分辨率计算的任务自适应频率注入方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable when predictions require fine-grained visual evidence. We identify a previously overlooked cause: spectral response rigidity. Despite substantial frequency variation across images and tasks, pretrained vision encoders exhibit persistent, encoder-specific layerwise spectral profiles that change only marginally under downstream fine-tuning. Since pretrained vision encoders only receive images, they cannot adapt spectral extraction to the evidence required by the current query. We therefore propose HAFI-VLM, which introduces a task-conditioned frequency pathway while preserving the pretrained semantic representation. Hierarchical Adaptive Frequency Injection (HAFI) retrieves complementary low-, mid-, and high-frequency evidence at multiple encoder depths using text-modulated, spatially aligned cross-attention. A Visual Enrichment Layer Adapter further recalibrates shallow LLM attention to effectively utilize the enriched visual tokens. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL demonstrate consistent improvements in general VQA, text-rich understanding, and hallucination robustness, outperforming representation-level enhancement methods and most resolution- or cropping-based approaches without additional high-resolution encoding. Mechanistic analyses show that HAFI restores task-dependent spectral allocation while retaining semantic attention, establishing frequency enrichment as a distinct and effective route for improving VLM perception.

</details>


### [226] [PromptPath: Prompt-Adaptive Computational Pathways for In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02129)
*Hangrui Zhang,Feifei Shao,Yawei Luo,Ping Liu,Jiaxiang Liu,Zuoqi Tang,Zhao Wang,Hongwei Wang,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PromptPath，一种自适应上下文学习（ICL）框架，通过提示条件动态路由机制选择性激活并组合轻量级低秩专家，形成任务特化的计算路径，从而实现计算层面的任务适应，提升模型的任务专业化程度和推理可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL方法存在"浅层任务适应"问题：提示仅作为上下文线索通过语义表征隐式推断任务意图，而底层计算过程保持不变。这限制了任务特化适应能力和推理可解释性。作者认为提示不仅应调节特征表示，还应动态调节模型的计算路径。

Method: 提出PromptPath框架，核心包括：(1) 提示驱动的路由机制，用于选择性激活和组合轻量级低秩专家；(2) 针对不同提示形成任务特化的计算路径；(3) 将提示信息直接整合到推理过程中，动态重构模型计算。

Result: 在3D点云和2D视觉识别基准上进行大量实验，PromptPath持续优于最先进的ICL基线方法，同时展现出强大的跨域和跨任务泛化能力。

Conclusion: PromptPath证明了计算级适应对ICL的重要性，通过将提示从单纯的特征条件提升为计算路径的调节器，实现了更深层次的任务适应和更优的可解释性。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) has attracted increasing attention for enabling models to perform new tasks using only a few ``input--output'' prompt examples. However, existing approaches suffer from \textbf{shallow task adaptation}, where prompts are primarily used as contextual cues to implicitly infer task intent through semantic representations, while the underlying computational process remains unchanged. This limitation restricts task-specific adaptation and compromises inference interpretability. We argue that prompts should not only condition feature representations but also dynamically regulate the model's computation pathways. To this end, we propose \textbf{PromptPath}, an adaptive ICL framework that enables computation-level adaptation through prompt-conditioned dynamic pathways. Specifically, PromptPath introduces a prompt-driven routing mechanism to selectively activate and compose lightweight low-rank experts, forming task-specific computational pathways tailored to different prompts. By integrating prompt information directly into the inference process, PromptPath dynamically reconfigures model computation to enhance task specialization and interpretability. Extensive experiments on 3D point cloud and 2D visual recognition benchmarks demonstrate that PromptPath consistently outperforms state-of-the-art ICL baselines while exhibiting strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization.

</details>


### [227] [Messages, Not Tokens: Grounded Coresets for Faithful VLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02134)
*Long Qian,Jiaqi Wei,Bingke Zhu,Yingying Chen,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为GMC（Grounded Message Coreset Pruning）的训练无关视觉压缩方法，通过构建覆盖多种证据模式的紧凑核心集（coreset）来替代传统的Top-K独立重要性评分方法，将丢弃的视觉状态转移到选定的代表token上，从而在显著减少视觉token的同时保持甚至提升VLM的推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于评分的视觉压缩方法为每个token分配独立重要性分数并保留Top-K，但文本查询消费的是来自视觉群体（population）的集体有符号注意力消息，而非孤立补丁。这导致等大小的Top-K集可能重复覆盖同一显著区域、遗漏稀疏但互补的证据，并丢弃被移除群体携带的信息，造成不忠实的视觉压缩。

Method: GMC方法：(1) 将忠实视觉压缩形式化为构建解码器消息的紧凑核心集问题；(2) 联合分配支撑覆盖查询接地（query-grounded）、外观（appearance）和坐标感知（coordinate-aware）证据；(3) 在物理压缩和原生注意力恢复之前，将丢弃状态转移到原始多模态位置上的选定代表；(4) 将压缩分解为两个耦合组件：选择覆盖所需消息模式的载体，以及在载体上实现有符号群体消息；(5) 推导连接组件误差与有符号消息失真、视觉创新和候选边际稳定性的界。

Result: 在多个VLM家族和多样化基准上的实验表明，GMC-H2在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上仅使用80.2%更少的视觉token即可保留97.78%的Full-relative平均能力，GMC-L16甚至达到100.36%。受控干预实验验证了集体支撑和群体实现共同驱动这些性能提升。

Conclusion: GMC证明了从"独立重要性评分"转向"群体消息的集体支撑"是更有效的视觉压缩范式，其核心集构建方法既能保持忠实性又能大幅降低推理成本，为VLM的高效推理提供了新思路。

Abstract: Modern vision language models (VLMs) turn high-resolution images into long sequences of visual tokens. Every token traverses the language decoder and persists in its prompt KV cache, inflating inference cost and motivating aggressive visual compression. Existing score-based methods assign each token an independent importance score and retain the Top-K. However, text queries consume collective, signed attention messages from the visual population, not isolated patches. Consequently, equally sized Top-K sets can repeatedly cover one salient region, omit sparse but complementary evidence and discard information carried by the removed population. We therefore formulate faithful visual compression as constructing a compact coreset for decoder messages, and introduce our training-free Grounded Message Coreset Pruning (GMC) which jointly allocates support across query-grounded, appearance, and coordinate-aware evidence, then transports discarded states into selected representatives at their original multimodal positions before physical compaction and native attention resume. This decomposes faithful compression into two coupled components, including selecting carriers that cover the required message modes and realizing the signed population message on those carriers. We further derive bounds connecting their errors to signed-message distortion, visual innovation, and candidate-margin stability. Experiments across multiple VLM families and diverse benchmarks demonstrate strong performance, with GMC-H2 retaining 97.78% Full-relative mean capability on Qwen2.5-VL-7B using 80.2% fewer visual tokens, while GMC-L16 reaches 100.36%. Controlled interventions verify that collective support and population realization jointly drive these gains.

</details>


### [228] [Two Sides of the Same Coin: Co-Evolving Search for Cross-Task Attacks on Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02137)
*Xuanhui Lin,Junhao Dong,Mingrong Gong,Yucheng Chen,Xinghua Qu,Yew-Soon Ong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架，用于统一视觉语言模型（VLMs）。该框架在文本侧进化硬负样本语义嵌入，在视觉侧结合动量梯度更新与进化选择/变异/交叉操作维护目标区域扰动种群，联合优化以生成跨任务可迁移的对抗样本，在Florence-2、OFA和UnifiedIO-2上验证了其在图像描述、目标检测等任务上的攻击效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对VLMs的攻击方法通常采用单轨迹梯度优化或任务特定目标，限制了搜索空间探索和跨任务可迁移性，难以在统一VLMs上产生有效的对抗扰动。

Method: 提出进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架：(1) 文本侧进化硬负样本语义嵌入，围绕源类别表示产生多样化的跨模态排斥；(2) 视觉侧维护目标区域扰动种群，融合动量梯度更新与进化的选择、变异、交叉操作，探索多条可行轨迹；(3) 联合优化语义负向引导和局部扰动，将源目标语义向目标类别转移。

Result: 在Florence-2、OFA和UnifiedIO-2上进行实验，在图像描述、目标检测、区域分类和目标定位任务中表现出强攻击性能。消融实验验证了文本侧语义进化与图像侧扰动进化的互补有效性，并展示了框架的高效性和跨任务可迁移性。理论分析证明共进化搜索保持扰动可行性、防止最优适应度退化，并相比单轨迹优化提高达到高裕度对抗区域的概率。

Conclusion: 进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架通过联合优化文本语义和视觉扰动，显著提升了对抗攻击在统一VLMs上的有效性和跨任务可迁移性，为多模态模型的安全性研究提供了新视角。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong generalization across multimodal tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing attacks typically follow single-trajectory gradient optimization or task-specific objectives, limiting search-space exploration and cross-task transferability. We propose an evolutionary-computation-guided cross-modal attack framework for unified VLMs. The framework adaptively searches both textual and visual spaces. On the textual side, it evolves hard negative semantic embeddings around the source-category representation to provide diverse cross-modal repulsion. On the visual side, it maintains a population of object-region perturbations and combines momentum-based gradient updates with evolutionary selection, mutation, and crossover to more reliably explore multiple feasible trajectories. Jointly optimizing semantic negative guidance and localized perturbations generates adversarial examples that consistently shift source-object semantics toward target categories across vision-language tasks. Theoretical analyses show that the co-evolutionary search preserves perturbation feasibility, prevents degradation of the best observed fitness, and increases the probability of reaching high-margin adversarial regions compared with single-trajectory optimization. Experiments on Florence-2, OFA, and UnifiedIO-2 demonstrate strong overall attack performance across image captioning, object detection, region categorization, and object localization. Ablation studies further verify the complementary effectiveness of text-side semantic evolution and image-side perturbation evolution, as well as the framework's efficiency and cross-task transferability.

</details>


### [229] [HiResNets: Native Full-HD Video Recognition with Foveal Residual Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02140)
*Shivani Mall,Swarnim Jain,Joao F. Henriques*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HiResNets，一种利用残差网络残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区的架构，通过log-polar图像扭曲操作让卷积块只读写焦点附近的高分辨率区域，将计算复杂度从二次方增长降为对数平方增长，使模型能够快速处理超高清视频，在自我中心视频识别任务中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来图像和视频识别的进展依赖于更大的模型、更高的分辨率和更长的时序上下文，但基于网格采样的卷积网络和视觉Transformer在高分辨率下存在内存和计算量呈二次方（或更高）增长的问题，这成为处理高分辨率视频的瓶颈。

Method: 利用残差网络的残差流作为高分辨率缓冲区，卷积块通过log-polar图像扭曲操作仅读写焦点附近区域；网络自适应地聚焦于每帧不同部分，焦点附近才使用超高分辨率；通过残差流逐步构建完整的高分辨率表示，类比生物视觉中的眼跳（saccade）机制，并给出消除残差流分辨率二次依赖的理论构造。

Result: 实验表明HiResNets能够类似人类视觉一样感知场景（foveation），在困难的自我中心（egocentric）视频识别任务中表现优于现有方法，尤其在小物体和细粒度识别场景中优势显著。

Conclusion: HiResNets通过模拟生物视觉的中央凹注视机制，在残差流中构建高分辨率表示，在保持高效计算的同时实现高分辨率视频处理，为视觉识别中的高分辨率计算问题提供了一种新思路。

Abstract: Much of the recent progress in image and video recognition has come at the cost of memory: larger models, increased resolution, and longer temporal contexts. An inevitable component is the quadratic (or larger) growth of memory and compute based on image resolution, which is a property of the grid sampling used in convolutional networks and vision transformers. In this work we study residual networks whose convolutional blocks have logarithmic-square growth instead, enabling them to process very high-resolution video quickly. The key insight is to use a residual architecture's residual stream as a high-resolution buffer, to which convolutional blocks only read and write via log-polar image warp operations. Layers adaptively focus on different parts of each frame, with very high resolution only near the focus point. A complete high-resolution representation is built up in the residual stream, analogous to eye saccades creating a complete picture in biological vision, and a theoretical construction is presented that eliminates the quadratic dependency of the residual stream resolution. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed HiResNets learn to foveate around scenes similarly to human vision, and have superior performance in difficult egocentric video recognition tasks, especially egocentric video with small objects and fine-grained recognition.

</details>


### [230] [Quaternion Tensor Modeling for Joint Color-Polarization Demosaicking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02144)
*Yanqing Song,Jifei Miao,Chaoqian Li,Rui Mei,Kit Ian Kou,Liqiao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于四元数张量和Stokes域总变分正则化的彩色偏振去马赛克（CPDM）方法。该方法将0°、45°、90°和135°四个偏振方向采集的彩色偏振图像编码为三阶四元数张量的四个分量，利用低秩先验挖掘全局结构冗余，并通过正交变换将空间梯度映射到Stokes域，结合自适应四元数权重实现分量特定的正则化，从而有效解决DoFP彩色偏振相机中稀疏采样导致的病态去马赛克问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DoFP彩色偏振相机虽然能快照采集彩色偏振马赛克图像，但其固有的稀疏采样模式使得彩色偏振去马赛克问题严重病态。现有方法未能联合利用偏振通道间的相关性和偏振成像固有的物理约束，导致明显的去马赛克伪影。

Method: 1. 通过相关性分析发现偏振通道间的相关性优于颜色通道间；2. 将四个偏振方向（0°,45°,90°,135°）的彩色偏振图像编码为三阶四元数张量的四个分量，颜色通道沿第三模排列；3. 对四元数张量施加低秩先验以利用彩色偏振数据的全局结构冗余；4. 通过正交变换将空间梯度映射到Stokes域以分离强度、偏振和残差变化，使用自适应四元数权重实现分量特定正则化并保持Stokes向量重建的能量一致性；5. 推导高效的优化算法求解该模型。

Result: 大量实验表明所提出的方法在去马赛克性能上优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过四元数张量编码框架有效联合利用了偏振通道相关性、低秩先验和Stokes域物理约束，显著提升了彩色偏振去马赛克的质量，减少了伪影。

Abstract: Division-of-focal-plane (DoFP) color polarization cameras enable snapshot acquisition of color polarization mosaic images, but the inherently sparse sampling pattern makes color polarization demosaicking severely ill-posed. Existing methods often fail to jointly exploit the correlations among polarization channels and the physical constraints inherent in polarization imaging, resulting in noticeable demosaicking artifacts. To address this issue, a quaternion-tensor-based color polarization demosaicking (CPDM) method incorporating Stokes-domain total variation (TV) regularization is proposed. Correlation analysis shows that the correlations among polarization channels are stronger than those among color channels. Accordingly, the color polarization images acquired at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ are encoded into the four components of a third-order quaternion tensor, with the color channels organized along its third mode. A low-rank prior is then imposed on the quaternion tensor to exploit the global structural redundancy in the color polarization data. Moreover, spatial gradients are mapped to the Stokes domain through an orthogonal transformation to separate intensity, polarization and residual variations, with adaptive quaternion weights enabling component-specific regularization and preserving the energy consistency of the reconstructed Stokes vectors. An efficient optimization algorithm is derived for the resulting model. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior demosaicking performance of the proposed method.

</details>


### [231] [UniqueSplat: View-conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Generalizable 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02145)
*Haixu Song,Xiaoke Yang,Shengjun Zhang,Jiwen Lu,Yueqi Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniqueSplat 提出了一种基于视图条件的前馈 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）模型，通过将目标视图信息作为先验嵌入网络参数，动态调整高斯分布以适配特定视角的重建需求，在 RealEstate10K、ACID 和 DTU 数据集上超越现有方法，并展现出更强的跨数据集泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈方法（如 pixelSplat、MVSplat）为每个场景生成固定的高斯分布，其预测过程未纳入目标视图信息，导致渲染结果无法针对特定视角进行适应性调整。作者旨在解决这一局限，使高斯重建能动态适配不同视图查询。

Method: 提出两分支视图条件超网络（two-branch view-conditioned hyperNetwork），同时学习视图无关的嵌入（view-agnostic embeddings）和视图特定知识（view-specific knowledge），将目标视角信息作为先验注入网络参数，从而在测试时动态调整高斯分布。

Result: 在 RealEstate10K、ACID 和 DTU 等广泛使用的数据集上超越现有最先进方法，并在跨数据集评估中表现更优，展示了显著的泛化能力。

Conclusion: UniqueSplat 通过视图条件化策略有效提升了 3D 高斯重建对特定视角的适应能力，并验证了该方法在泛化性上的优势。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose UniqueSplat, a view-conditioned feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting model to reconstruct customized 3D radiance fields for each view query. Existing feed-forward methods such as pixelSplat and MVSplat aim to generate fixed Gaussians across all views of each scene by minimizing the error between rendered views and ground-truth images. However, such fixed Gaussians generally render images from all views and lack the ability to adapt to specific viewpoints, as they do not incorporate target view information when predicting Gaussians. To address this, our UniqueSplat learns the view-conditioned information as a prior and incorporates this knowledge into network parameters, so that Gaussians are dynamically adjusted in accordance with different views. Specifically, we propose a two-branch view-conditioned hyperNetwork to simultaneously learn view-agnostic embeddings and view-specific knowledge, which not only explores the shareable knowledge from various views, but also adapts the model to specific views at test time. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including RealEstate10K, ACID and DTU demonstrate the superiority of UniqueSplat over the state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, UniqueSplat encouragingly outperforms existing methods in cross-dataset evaluation, showing its notable generalization ability.

</details>


### [232] [PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02150)
*Zhongjie Ba,Shengwang Xu,Peng Cheng,Jinyang Zou,Ting Yu,Zhibo Wang,Zhan Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PhyCheck，一个用于评估和提升视频大语言模型物理规律理解能力的视频问答数据集。数据集包含粗粒度（判断是否符合物理规律）、细粒度（识别具体物理细节）和诊断性子集（引入外部因果上下文），实验表明微调Qwen2.5-VL后物理一致性理解显著提升，但模型在融合外部因果条件方面仍有困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频语言模型在通用视频理解任务上表现优异，但难以可靠判断事件是否符合特定物理规律。已有基准主要评估生成视频的物理质量，缺乏系统性评估和改进VideoLLMs物理规律理解的工具，因此需要专门的数据集来弥补这一空白。

Method: 构建PhyCheck视频问答数据集，包含三个互补的粒度层级：粗粒度子集判断视频现象是否符合物理规律；细粒度子集检验模型能否捕捉导致符合或违反物理规律的细节；诊断性子集引入外部因果上下文，评估模型能否根据隐藏因素重新校准判断。使用这些数据作为结构化监督微调Qwen2.5-VL。

Result: 使用PhyCheck数据微调Qwen2.5-VL后，模型对物理一致性的理解显著提升。但诊断性子集的评估显示，当前模型在将额外因果条件纳入决策时仍存在困难，表明表面不一致识别与深层物理机制理解之间仍有差距。

Conclusion: PhyCheck为评估和改进VideoLLMs的物理理解能力提供了基础。研究揭示了模型在识别表面不一致与理解底层物理机制之间的鸿沟，强调了深入理解物理规律对于具身智能和世界模型的重要性。

Abstract: Embodied intelligence and world models require video understanding systems to go beyond recognizing objects and actions and develop an understanding of physical regularities. However, despite their strong performance on general video understanding tasks, current video-language models still struggle to reliably determine whether an observed event conforms to specific physical laws. Existing benchmarks primarily assess the physical quality of generated videos, providing limited support for systematically evaluating and improving the physical-law understanding of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs). To address this gap, we introduce PhyCheck, a video question answering dataset organized at two complementary levels of granularity. The coarse-grained subset asks models to determine whether the phenomenon shown in a video conforms to or violates physical laws, while the fine-grained subset further examines whether models can capture physical details responsible for the violation or compliance. We use these subsets as structured supervision to improve physical understanding. In addition, the dataset contains a diagnostic subset with external causal context that reveal hidden factors affecting physical plausibility, assessing whether models can recalibrate their judgments accordingly. Experiments with Fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL show that training with the proposed data substantially improves the understanding of physical-consistency, while evaluations in the diagnostic subset reveal that current models still have difficulty incorporating additional causal conditions into their decisions. These findings highlight the gap between recognizing surface-level inconsistencies and understanding underlying physical mechanisms, and provide a foundation for evaluating and improving physical understanding in Video-LLMs.

</details>


### [233] [AdaForensics: Learning A Characteristic-aware Adaptive Deepfake Detector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02160)
*Xiaoke Yang,Haixu Song,Xiangyu Lu,Shao-Lun Huang,Yueqi Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为AdaForensics的特征感知自适应网络用于深度伪造检测。与现有方法对所有图像使用固定检测器不同，AdaForensics通过同时学习特征无关和特征特定的嵌入，并利用双分支超网络根据输入人脸的特征动态调整检测器参数，从而实现个性化的伪造检测，在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法通常使用固定的网络架构对所有图像采用相同的检测器，忽略了不同个体具有不同的面部特征。这种"一刀切"的检测方式无法针对不同个体提供定制化的伪造检测，导致检测性能受限。

Method: 提出AdaForensics，包括两条核心设计：1）同时学习特征无关（characteristic-agnostic）和特征特定（characteristic-specific）的嵌入，既探索各类深度伪造图像的共享抽象特征，又能适应个体的特定特征；2）设计一个双分支HyperNetwork（超网络）来学习自适应深度伪造检测器，该网络能够根据输入特征自动调整检测器的参数，实现在测试时动态适配不同的面部特征。

Result: 在FaceForensics、Celeb-DF和DFDC等广泛使用的数据集上进行了大量实验，实验结果表明AdaForensics在深度伪造检测性能上优于当前最先进的方法。

Conclusion: 通过引入特征感知的自适应机制，使深度伪造检测器能够根据个体面部特征动态调整，有效提升了对不同人群伪造图像的检测能力，验证了自适应检测思路的有效性。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a characteristic-aware adaptive network named AdaForensics for deepfake detection. Most existing methods learn a fixed network to detect deepfakes based on carefully-designed network architectures. However, these methods employ the same deepfake detector for all the images despite of various facial characteristic, which fail to provide customized forgery detection for different individuals. To address this, our AdaForensics simultaneously learns characteristic-agnostic and characteristic-specific embeddings, where the detector dynamically adapts to varying faces with our designed hypernetwork on the fly. More specifically, our AdaForensics not only explores the shareable abstractions from various deepfake images, but also adapts the detector to the given characteristic at test time. To achieve this, we propose a two-branch HyperNetwork to learn an adaptive deepfake detector, which automatically adjusts the parameters based on characteristic of the input. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including FaceForensics, Celeb-DF and DFDC demonstrate our AdaForensics outperforms the state-of-the-art works.

</details>


### [234] [GSRAIN: Physically Calibrated High-/Low-Frequency Rainfall Synthesis for 3D Gaussian Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02177)
*Fanyu Wang,Longgao Zhang,Junyi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GSRAIN是一种面向3D高斯溅射（3DGS）驾驶场景的高/低频降雨合成方法，通过高频雨滴模型和几何感知单步扩散模型生成逼真雨景，支持0-13mm/h的降雨强度控制，FID达到149.09，优于CycleGAN-Turbo和WeatherEdit，并能为自动驾驶提供物理可控、可重复且兼容闭环的雨天测试场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动驾驶降雨仿真方法在物理可控性和多视图一致性方面存在局限，难以满足自动驾驶系统在可重复、可控雨天场景下进行可靠测试的需求。

Method: GSRAIN构建了一个高频雨滴模型（基于实测降雨数据）和一个低频雨景外观生成模型（使用几何感知的单步扩散模型），然后将两种效果在统一的3DGS场景中融合，实现0-13mm/h范围的降雨强度控制。

Result: GSRAIN的FID为149.09，优于CycleGAN-Turbo（155.71）和WeatherEdit（157.94）。目标检测和闭环驾驶实验表明，生成场景能展现评估算法在可控降雨条件下场景相关的性能变化。

Conclusion: GSRAIN为自动驾驶提供了一种有效的方法来构建物理可控、可重复且兼容闭环的雨天天气测试场景。

Abstract: Existing rainfall simulation methods for autonomous driving remain limited in physical controllability and multi-view consistency. This paper presents GSRAIN, a high-/low-frequency rainfall synthesis method for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) driving scenes. GSRAIN constructs a high-frequency raindrop model from measured rainfall data and generates low-frequency rainy appearance using a geometry-aware single-step diffusion model. The two effects are then fused in a unified 3DGS scene, enabling rainfall-intensity control over the range of 0--13~mm/h. The proposed method achieves a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 149.09, outperforming CycleGAN-Turbo (155.71) and WeatherEdit (157.94). Object-detection and closed-loop driving experiments further show that the generated scenes expose scene-dependent performance changes of the evaluated algorithms under controllable rainfall. These results indicate that GSRAIN provides an effective approach for constructing physically controllable, repeatable, and closed-loop-compatible rainy-weather test scenes for autonomous driving.

</details>


### [235] [SWINSleepNet: A Hierarchical Context-Aware Framework for Sleep Staging (v2)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02183)
*Chongjian Wang,Junjie Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了SwinSleepNet，一个分层上下文感知的双流框架，通过分别优化epoch内表示学习和epoch间上下文建模来提升自动睡眠分期性能，特别是在困难的N1阶段和过渡期epoch上表现更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动睡眠分期方法在模糊和过渡相关的睡眠阶段（如N1期）上性能较差，原因是缺乏对细粒度epoch内结构和复杂跨区域频谱依赖关系的建模。传统的epoch级编码器无法提取微妙的时间微结构和epoch内跨区域交互。

Method: 提出SwinSleepNet双流框架：(1) 时域分支使用卷积编码器捕获精细波形时间细节；(2) 时频分支使用Swin Transformer提取局部频谱-时间特征、分层多尺度信息和长距离空间依赖；(3) 多分支特征融合为集成嵌入，通过双向上下文模块捕获跨epoch时间依赖用于最终分类。

Result: 在Sleep-EDF-20、Sleep-EDF-78和SHHS三个数据集上的综合实验验证了方法的竞争力，在困难的N1阶段和过渡epoch上表现出更强的鲁棒性和稳定性。

Conclusion: 基于分层架构优化的epoch内表示学习对自动睡眠分期任务大有裨益。

Abstract: Automatic sleep staging is a critical role in sleep disorder diagnosis, sleep quality assessment, and long-term health monitoring; however, existing approaches suffer poor performance on ambiguous and transition-related sleep stages, caused by inadequate modeling of fine-grained intra-epoch structures and complex cross-region spectral dependencies. Traditional epoch-level encoders commonly fail to extract subtle temporal microstructures and intra-epoch cross-region interactions, resulting in unsatisfactory recognition accuracy for hard categories such as the N1 stage. To tackle these drawbacks, we propose SwinSleepNet, a hierarchical context-aware dual-stream framework that separately optimizes intra-epoch representation learning and inter-epoch contextual modeling. Concretely, we characterize each sleep epoch from two complementary perspectives: raw time-domain EEG signal and its time-frequency transformation. The time-domain branch adopts convolutional encoders to capture fine waveform temporal details, and the time-frequency branch uses Swin Transformer to extract local spectro-temporal features, hierarchical multi-scale information and long-range spatial dependencies. The multi-branch extracted features are fused into integrated embeddings, which are optimized by a bidirectional context module to capture cross-epoch temporal dependencies for final sleep stage classification. Comprehensive experiments on Sleep-EDF-20, Sleep-EDF-78 and SHHS datasets verify that our method achieves competitive overall performance, and exhibits stronger robustness and stability on difficult N1 stages and transitional epochs. The results prove that optimized intra-epoch representation learning based on hierarchical architecture greatly benefits automatic sleep staging tasks.

</details>


### [236] [SPIRIT: Spatio-temporal Pairwise Relational Modeling of Instrument-Tissue Interactions for Surgical Action Triplet Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02188)
*Saurav Sharma,Lorenzo Arboit,Nabani Banik,Sarah Meuli,Julia Alekseenko,Jan Liechti,Franziska Heitzinger,Michela Orsi,Didier Mutter,Daniel Gero,Philipp C. Nett,Beat P. Muller,Joel L. Lavanchy,Nicolas Padoy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPIRIT框架，用于跨中心（多机构）的外科手术动作三元组识别。SPIRIT不再将三元组视为扁平类别标签，而是分别学习器械、动词和目标的时空表示，建模两两关系，再组合为一致的三元组预测，并通过多头蒸馏稳定训练。同时建立了MultiBypass-4C-T40多中心数据集，包含四个地理分散中心的Roux-en-Y胃旁路手术视频及阶段/步骤标注，验证了结构化关系推理在多中心泛化中的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外科手术视频在不同机构之间存在采集条件、术者风格、器械使用和组织处理方式的差异，导致三元组识别模型跨中心迁移可靠性差。现有三元组数据集不支持显式的中心间迁移评估，这是一个未被解决的关键问题。

Method: SPIRIT框架包含三个步骤：(1) 分别学习器械、动词、目标的时空表示；(2) 建模三者之间的两两关系；(3) 将关系组合为连贯的三元组预测。训练过程中使用多头蒸馏（multi-head distillation）来稳定学习过程。

Result: 在多种评估协议下，SPIRIT一致优于强基准模型，证明了显式关系推理对多中心三元组识别的价值。同时构建了MultiBypass-4C-T40数据集，支持中心间迁移评估。

Conclusion: 结构化关系建模相比扁平类别分类能显著提升手术动作三元组识别的跨中心泛化能力，为手术室中的上下文感知辅助（安全监控、不良事件识别、技能评估）提供了更可靠的表示基础。

Abstract: Fine-grained understanding of surgical activity is essential for context-aware assistance in the operating room, including safety monitoring, adverse event identification, and skill assessment. Surgical action triplets, defined as tuples of the form <instrument, verb, target>, provide a structured description of instrument-tissue interactions. A key open problem, however, is how to learn triplet representations that remain reliable across institutions, where surgical video varies in acquisition conditions, surgeon style, tool usage, and tissue handling, while existing triplet datasets do not support explicit evaluation of center-wise transfer. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{SPIRIT}, a structured framework for surgical action triplet recognition designed to learn interaction representations that transfer more reliably across centers. Instead of treating each triplet as a flat class label, SPIRIT first learns spatio-temporal representations for instruments, verbs, and targets, then models their pairwise relations, and finally composes them into coherent triplet predictions, with multi-head distillation used to stabilize learning. To evaluate this setting, we establish \textbf{MultiBypass-4C-T40}, a multi-centric dataset for dense surgical action triplet recognition in Roux-en-Y gastric bypass across four geographically distinct centers, with auxiliary phase and step annotations. Across multiple evaluation protocols, SPIRIT consistently outperforms strong recent baselines, highlighting the value of explicit relational reasoning for multi-centric triplet recognition. Code will be available at https://github.com/CAMMA-public/multibypass-4c-t40.

</details>


### [237] [DerainSplat: Feed-Forward Clean 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Rainy Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02191)
*Fuzhen Jiang,Changyue Shi,Chuxiao Yang,Xinyuan Hu,Wenjie Ye,Minghao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DerainSplat是一个前馈式框架，能从少量雨雾视图重建干净的3D场景。它通过四阶段合成管线构建多视角去雨数据集，并利用天气网络预测天气因子来调制跨视角匹配和外观融合，从而在恶劣天气下实现鲁棒的3D场景重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像去雨方法主要聚焦于2D图像恢复，而随着具身智能和自动驾驶等空间智能应用的发展，从稀疏雨雾视图前馈式重建干净3D场景变得日益重要。现有的前馈式3D高斯泼溅方法通常假设输入干净，在雨雾条件下会崩溃。

Method: 1) 构建大规模多视角去雨数据集，通过四阶段合成管线（阴天光照、深度相关雾霾、雨条纹、镜头雨滴）生成带特权天气因子的数据；2) 引入天气网络从雨景上下文预测天气因子并生成两种支持图；3) 场景支持图调制跨视角代价体匹配，辐射支持图驱动深度对齐的外观融合以填补损坏像素；4) 几何证据衰减高斯不透明度以减少虚假结构；5) 雨循环一致性机制用预测因子重新渲染干净视图并与雨景输入对齐。

Result: 在RealEstate10K、ACID、Mip-NeRF360及真实雨景场景等多个数据集上，DerainSplat优于现有方法，并展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力。

Conclusion: DerainSplat首次将前馈式3DGS从2D去雨扩展到3D场景重建领域，通过天气因子预测与循环一致性机制有效解决恶劣天气下的重建问题，为空间智能应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Although image deraining has advanced substantially, existing methods mainly focus on 2D image restoration. As spatial intelligence applications such as embodied AI and autonomous driving continue to emerge, reconstructing clean 3D scenes from sparse rainy views in a feed-forward manner becomes increasingly important. Existing feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods often assume clean inputs and collapse under rainy conditions. To this end, we present \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}}, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs clean 3D scenes from only a few rainy views. To support this task, we build a large-scale multi-view derain dataset through a four-stage synthesis pipeline that sequentially models overcast illumination, depth-dependent haze, rain streaks, and lens raindrops, producing privileged weather factors. We introduce a weather net that predicts the weather factors from rainy context and yields two support maps. Scene support modulates cross-view cost-volume matching, while radiance support drives depth-aligned appearance fusion to fill corrupted pixels. The derived geometry evidence further attenuates Gaussian opacity to reduce spurious structures. A rainy cycle consistency re-renders clean views using the predicted factors and aligns them with rainy inputs. Extensive experiments show that \textbf{\textit{DerainSplat}} outperforms existing methods on various datasets, including RealEstate10K, ACID, Mip-NeRF360, and real-world rainy scenes, with strong cross-dataset generalization.

</details>


### [238] [T$^2$exture: Sparsely Perturbed Thermal-to-Texture Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02192)
*Jiashuo Chen,Cheng Dai,Yanan Hu,Fanglin Bao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出T²exture，一种稀疏扰动热纹理成像框架，通过密集被动帧和少量主动扰动关键帧重建时间密集的热纹理序列。热纹理被定义为源开启观测与源关闭被动状态之间的残差，该方法通过两阶段重建（先估计未观测的被动状态获得差分纹理锚点，再结合稀疏锚点与被动结构上下文重建密集序列），在模拟基准上仅增加0.20M参数即提升PSNR 6.66 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被动长波红外（LWIR）成像在光照不利条件下有效，但缺乏精细纹理。现有热纹理成像方法依赖光谱传感或注册辅助模态，存在数据吞吐量大或易受跨模态退化影响的问题。

Method: T²exture框架：将热纹理定义为源开启观测与源关闭被动状态间的残差；在稀疏LWIR照明和快速准稳态配对采集下，该残差衰减被动发射背景并近似源诱导反射响应。两阶段重建：Stage 1从邻近被动帧估计每个主动时刻未观测的源关闭被动状态，获得可靠的差分纹理锚点；Stage 2结合稀疏锚点与目标时刻附近的被动结构上下文重建密集序列。

Result: 在模拟基准上，T²exture仅增加0.20M参数到AMT-L，PSNR提升6.66 dB。在模拟和真实采集数据上的广泛评估显示，相比代表性VFI基线，能恢复更清晰的纹理和保持更强的结构。

Conclusion: T²exture被确立为一种在稀疏主动采集条件下进行热纹理成像的实用框架，有效解决了被动LWIR成像纹理不足的问题。

Abstract: Thermal imaging remains effective under adverse illumination, yet passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) measurements often lack fine texture. Existing thermal texture imaging approaches commonly rely on spectral sensing or registered auxiliary modalities, incurring substantial data throughput or vulnerability to cross-modal degradation. We introduce T$^2$exture, a sparsely perturbed thermal texture imaging framework that aims to reconstruct temporally dense thermal texture sequences from densely sampled passive frames and a few actively perturbed keyframes. We define thermal texture as the residual between a source-on observation and its corresponding source-off passive state. Under sparse LWIR illumination and rapid quasi-steady paired acquisition, this residual attenuates the passive-emission background and approximates a source-induced reflected response, exposing localized material- and geometry-dependent texture. T$^2$exture reconstructs a dense sequence of this source-conditioned response through two stages. Stage 1 estimates the unobserved source-off passive state at each active instant from neighboring passive frames to obtain reliable differential texture anchors. Stage 2 combines sparse anchors with passive structural context near each target time to reconstruct the dense sequence. On the simulated benchmark, T$^2$exture adds only 0.20M parameters to AMT-L while improving PSNR by 6.66 dB. Extensive evaluations on simulated and real acquisitions further show clearer texture recovery and stronger structural preservation than representative VFI baselines. These results establish T$^2$exture as a practical framework for thermal texture imaging under sparse active acquisition.

</details>


### [239] [RSC-GestureNet: Reliability-Aware Selective Causal Recognition of Chinese Traffic Police Gestures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02200)
*Cheng Li,Renjun Gao,Boyi Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RSC-GestureNet，一个面向中国交通警察手势的可靠性感知选择性因果识别器。模型将姿势置信度作为一等信号，在因果图推理中对不可靠关节点降权，并通过可靠性感知推理规则选择性输出校准预测。在官方CTPGesture v1完整分割上达到93.33%准确率，超过基线方法3-4个宏F1点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通警察手势是自动驾驶的安全关键感知线索。可部署的识别器必须从连续全帧视频中因果推断命令，在过渡性手臂运动期间保持稳定，并避免过度信任受损的姿势测量。现有方法未充分处理这些挑战。

Method: RSC-GestureNet采用三个关键机制：(1)将姿势置信度作为一等信号，在图中推理中对不可靠关节点降权；(2)时间证据因果聚合，确保在线可部署；(3)通过可靠性感知推理规则选择性输出校准预测。同时引入CTPGesture-C基准，包含七种姿势/RGB退化家族的干扰基准。

Result: 在CTPGesture v1完整分割（134,424标记帧、33,451个因果窗口）上达到93.33%准确率、91.71%宏F1、91.69%在线宏F1、98.80% Early@10、0.153秒TTC，鲁棒宏F1最佳。超过MD-GCN和HLP-GCN基线3.23-4.11个宏F1点和2.15-3.07个在线F1点。

Conclusion: 通过校准、选择性风险、统计、自适应分支和图像级重提取等分析表明，显式姿势可靠性建模能显著提升交通指令识别的早期性、稳定性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Traffic police gestures are safety-critical perception cues for autonomous driving. A deployable recognizer must infer commands causally from continuous full-frame video, remain stable around transitional arm motion, and avoid over-trusting corrupted pose measurements. This study presents RSC-GestureNet, a reliability-aware selective causal recognizer, for Chinese traffic police gestures. The model treats pose confidence as a first-class signal: unreliable joints are down weighted during graph reasoning, temporal evidence is aggregated causally, and calibrated predictions are selectively emitted through a reliability-aware inference rule. We further introduce CTPGesture-C, a reproducible feature-level corruption benchmark with seven pose/RGB degradation families, and an RGB-level diagnostic in which corrupted frames are reprocessed by MediaPipe before recognition. On the complete official CTPGesture v1 split (134,424 labeled frames and 33,451 causal windows), RSC-GestureNet achieves 93.33+-0.24% accuracy, 91.71+-0.27% macro-F1, 91.69+-0.29% online macro-F1, 98.80+-0.07% Early@10, 0.153+-0.013 s TTC, and the best robust macro-F1 among evaluated methods. Under the same split and causal protocol, it exceeds reproduced traffic-specific MD-GCN and HLP-GCN baselines by 3.23-4.11 macro-F1 points and 2.15-3.07 online-F1 points. These results, together with calibration, selective-risk, statistical, adaptive-branching, and image-level re-extraction analyses, indicate that explicit pose-reliability modeling improves early, stable, and robust traffic-command recognition.

</details>


### [240] [CLEAR: Conflict-aware Learning via Evidence-guided Adaptive Routing for Unified Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02206)
*Hantang Li,Qiang Zhu,Xiandong Meng,Debin Zhao,Xiaopeng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CLEAR是首个用于稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅超分辨率的统一单阶段框架，通过证据引导的自适应路由实现冲突感知学习，联合优化LR观测和HR先验，在合成和真实世界4倍超分辨率基准上达到最先进效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅超分辨率方法采用两阶段流程（先LR高斯重建再HR高斯细化），导致逐阶段的高斯传递和重建误差累积。稀疏且低分辨率的输入缺乏足够的几何和高频信息，使得高质量重建极具挑战性。

Method: CLEAR提出统一单阶段框架：（1）在统一高斯表示中联合优化真实LR观测和外部HR先验；（2）高斯级冲突感知优化策略，将LR梯度作为可靠锚点，对严重HR冲突应用证据条件软校正；（3）证据引导的Patch-to-Gaussian路由机制，估计patch可靠性和细节需求，选择性地路由高频梯度和致密化；（4）共享高斯dropout和分离的中间训练锚定以增强训练鲁棒性。

Result: 在合成和真实世界4倍超分辨率基准上的大量实验表明，CLEAR一致地实现了最先进的渲染质量和优越的几何保真度。

Conclusion: CLEAR通过统一单阶段训练框架有效解决了稀疏视角3D高斯超分辨率中的误差累积和梯度冲突问题，验证了冲突感知学习和证据引导路由机制的有效性。

Abstract: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Super-resolution is highly challenging since the sparse and low-resolution (LR) inputs lack sufficient geometric and high-frequency information for accurate reconstruction. To achieve high-quality reconstruction, existing sparse-view super-resolution methods adhere to two-stage pipeline that performs LR Gaussian reconstruction and then high-resolution (HR) Gaussian refinement, which directly results in stage-wise Gaussian transfer and reconstruction error accumulation. To this end, we propose CLEAR, a Conflict-aware Learning via Evidence-guided Adaptive Routing, as the first unified single-stage framework for Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Super-resolution. Specifically, CLEAR performs joint the optimization of authentic LR observations and external HR priors within a unified Gaussian representation. To mitigate the gradient conflicts introduced by sparse supervision during training, we propose a Gaussian-wise conflict-aware optimization strategy that regards the LR gradient as a reliable anchor and applies evidence-conditioned soft correction only to severe HR conflicts. Moreover, to recover high-frequency details, we introduce an evidence-guided Patch-to-Gaussian routing mechanism which estimates patch reliability and detail demand, lifts them into Gaussian space, and selectively routes high-frequency gradients and densification. Finally, we employ shared Gaussian dropout and a detached mid-training anchoring to enhance the robustness of training framework. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world $4\times$ super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that CLEAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and superior geometric fidelity.

</details>


### [241] [Self-supervised DXA representations encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02208)
*Gil Sasson,Zachary Levine,Smadar Shilo,Sarah Kohn,Guy Lutsker,Anastasia Godneva,Adam Gabet,David Krongauz,Adina Weinberger,Yann LeCun,Randall Balestriero,Eran Segal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LeDXA，一种基于JEPA架构的自监督视觉模型，从全身双能X射线吸收测定法（DXA）扫描中学习系统性健康表征。仅用11,540张无标注图像训练，在47,400张外部UK Biobank扫描上优于传统DXA测量和DINOv3，显著提升疾病预测、生物年龄估计和遗传关联分析性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全身DXA扫描常规用于测量骨密度和区域身体成分，但其丰富的空间结构信息被大量浪费。作者希望利用自监督学习从DXA图像中提取传统表格测量无法捕获的系统性健康信息，以改善疾病预测和健康评估。

Method: LeDXA采用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），通过预测潜在表征而非重建像素进行自监督学习。模型从11,540张无标注Human Phenotype Project扫描从头训练，并在47,400张外部UK Biobank扫描上评估。训练规模极小（约15万分之一于DINOv3的图像量，参数少近40倍）。

Result: LeDXA在跨队列疾病和生物标志物预测上优于传统DXA测量和DINOv3。髋/膝关节炎和2型糖尿病的发病预测增益最大；髋关节炎66%的发病案例落在最高风险四分位（表格测量为41%）。外部队列年龄预测r=0.88（MAE=2.90年），生物学年龄差距预测45%更高的死亡风险，且对激素替代疗法敏感。GWAS恢复已知位点，嵌入遗传度高于DINOv3。

Conclusion: DXA图像中包含常规测量丢弃的预后信息，这些信息可以通过相对较少的数据和适度的计算资源学习。LeDXA展示了医学成像中自监督表征学习在低资源场景下的巨大潜力，有望为精准医学提供新的生物标志物。

Abstract: Whole-body dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) scans are routinely acquired to measure bone density and regional body composition, leaving their spatial structure largely unused. Here, we show that self-supervised learning (SSL) can convert raw DXA images into representations of systemic health. We introduce LeDXA, a vision model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns by predicting latent representations rather than reconstructing pixels. Trained from scratch on 11,540 unlabeled Human Phenotype Project scans, LeDXA was evaluated internally and on 47,400 external UK Biobank (UKBB) scans. It improved cross-cohort prediction of prevalent diseases and biomarkers beyond scanner-derived DXA measurements and DINOv3, a state-of-the-art general-purpose model, despite approximately 150,000-fold fewer training images and nearly 40-fold fewer parameters. Over a median 4.3-year UKBB follow-up, LeDXA improved incident disease prediction over tabular DXA measures, with the largest gains for hip and knee arthrosis and type 2 diabetes. For hip arthrosis, 66% of incident cases occurred in the highest-risk quartile versus 41% for tabular measures. Its representations predicted chronological age externally (r = 0.88; mean absolute error = 2.90 years), and the biological-age gap tracked broader disease burden and a 45% higher mortality hazard in the oldest-appearing quartile. The gap also decreased in women after starting hormone-replacement therapy, suggesting it may be modifiable. Genome-wide associations recovered mostly known body-composition and bone-density loci, and LeDXA embeddings were more heritable than DINOv3's. These findings reveal prognostic information in DXA images that conventional readouts discard, learnable with relatively little data and modest compute.

</details>


### [242] [VARPose: Flexible 2D Pose Densification via Visual Autoregressive Modeling for Enhanced 3D Lifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02214)
*Kaiyuan Pu,Tiantian Yang,Dan Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VARPose提出将视觉自回归建模(VAR)从自然图像生成扩展到人体骨骼等拓扑结构数据，通过自适应稠化2D稀疏姿态来丰富3D提升模型可用的解剖信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VAR在自然图像生成中通过next-scale预测表现出色，但尚未被应用于人体骨骼这类拓扑结构数据。现有的姿态估计方法受限于稀疏姿态提供的有限解剖信息。

Method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) Granularity-agnostic Pose Tokenizer (GPT)，使用单一混合码本和残差量化策略，将不同密度的姿态编码为统一的多尺度离散表示；(2) UniSkelar，一个统一的自回归模型，将"关节密度"视为"尺度"，以从粗到细的方式预测下一密度级别的token序列，并以最稀疏姿态为条件。

Result: VARPose在性能上超越最先进方法，能够泛化到未见过的姿态粒度，并通过2D姿态稠化为下游任务（如3D姿态估计、人体网格恢复）带来实际的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过将表示与投影解耦，可以使用冻结的码本配合重训练的解码器成功解码新颖的姿态粒度。VARPose验证了将VAR范式扩展到拓扑结构数据的可行性，并展示了姿态稠化对下游任务的价值。

Abstract: Visual AutoRegressive Modeling (VAR) has excelled in natural image generation via next-scale prediction, but its use on topology-structured data like human skeletons is still unexplored. VARPose is proposed to adaptively densify 2D sparse poses, thereby enriching the anatomical information available for 3D lifting models. Our core contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a Granularity-agnostic Pose Tokenizer (GPT), which employs a single hybrid codebook and a residual quantization strategy to encode poses of varying densities into a unified, multi-scale discrete representation. Our results demonstrate the strong generalizability of this representation. By decoupling the representation from the projection, we can successfully decode novel pose granularities using a frozen codebook with a retrained decoder. Second, we propose UniSkelar, a unified autoregressive model that treats "joint density" as "scale". UniSkelar learns to predict the token sequence for the next density level in a coarse-to-fine manner, conditioned on the sparsest pose. VARPose not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods and generalizes to unseen granularities, but also confers tangible performance gains on downstream tasks, such as 3D Pose Estimation and Human Mesh Recovery, through 2D pose densification. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/VARPose.git.

</details>


### [243] [Local Margin Restoration for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02216)
*Yan Huang,Guowei Wang,Xu Wang,Kangjun Liu,Xin Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LMR（Local Margin Restoration），一个轻量级单步测试时自适应（TTA）框架，用于应对视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）在测试分布漂移下的性能退化问题。LMR通过样本级的Protected Margin Restoration目标和流级的双阶段稳定机制（Adaptive Margin控制器与Bias Correction），解决了传统TTA中的误差强化和渐进偏差累积导致模式崩溃的问题，在多个基准上超越SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型虽然在零样本场景表现优异，但在测试时的分布漂移下性能急剧下降。现有的TTA方法存在两个根本性缺陷：（1）传统的top-1-centric更新会通过破坏相关类之间的局部语义几何结构来强化错误；（2）迭代适应会加剧渐进偏差累积，最终导致模型模式崩溃。

Method: 提出LMR框架，包含两大核心组件：（1）样本层面的Protected Margin Restoration（PMR）目标——通过屏蔽合理的near-top候选候选类免受外部硬负样本干扰，恢复局部语义几何结构；（2）流级稳定机制——包括Adaptive Margin（AM）控制器和Bias Correction（BC），动态打破渐进偏差累积并防止模式崩溃。整体为轻量级、单步TTA框架。

Result: 在CIFAR-C、ImageNet-C和ImageNet变体数据集上的大量实验表明，LMR一致地优于现有最先进的TTA基线，在具有挑战性的低批次测试时场景中表现出色，兼具鲁棒性和高效性。

Conclusion: LMR通过同时解决样本级语义几何破坏和流级偏差累积这两个耦合问题，提供了一种鲁棒且高效的TTA解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities, yet their performance frequently degrades sharply under unexpected test-time distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising solution, continuously adapting VLMs over an unlabeled test stream presents fundamental challenges. Conventional top-1-centric updates often reinforce errors by corrupting the local semantic geometry among related classes, while iterative adaptation exacerbates progressive bias accumulation, ultimately driving the model toward mode collapse. To overcome these coupled vulnerabilities, we propose Local Margin Restoration (LMR), a lightweight, one-step TTA framework. At the sample level, our Protected Margin Restoration (PMR) objective recovers local semantic geometry by shielding plausible near-top candidates from external hard negatives. Concurrently, to combat stream-level degradation, we introduce a dual-stage stabilization mechanism, featuring an Adaptive Margin (AM) controller and Bias Correction (BC), to dynamically disrupt progressive bias accumulation and prevent mode collapse. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-C, ImageNet-C, and ImageNet variants demonstrate that LMR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA baselines, proving exceptionally robust and efficient even in challenging low-batch test-time regimes. Our code is available at https://github.com/DennisHuangYan/LMR.

</details>


### [244] [VC-Tooler: Learning Compositional and Adaptive Visual Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02217)
*Yizheng Wu,Jiashen Hua,Bing Deng,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VC-Tooler，一种将视觉工具使用学习为组合且自适应能力的框架。通过分层合成轨迹库覆盖单工具接地、多工具组合和多样化工具上下文三种能力层级，并采用两阶段训练（监督冷启动+强化学习）实现精确、高效且上下文感知的视觉工具使用，在V*（95.8%）和VTC-Bench（35.3%）等benchmark上达到开源模型最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体多模态推理方法主要聚焦于固定工具空间和刚性调用模式中的接地能力，而对工具组合（多步骤调用）和自适应推理（根据工具返回值调整策略）关注不足，限制了VLM在动态视觉环境中的实际应用能力。

Method: 1) 构建轨迹库：通过分层合成管道生成覆盖三个能力层级（单工具接地、多工具组合、多样工具上下文与接口）的训练数据；2) 两阶段训练：先进行监督冷启动以建立基础能力，再通过强化学习鼓励精确、高效且上下文感知的视觉工具使用。

Result: 在通用与智能体基准上均达到开源模型最优性能：V*上95.8%，VTC-Bench上35.3%，并在推理时更丰富的工具设置下展现出有前景的迁移能力。

Conclusion: VC-Tooler验证了将视觉工具使用建模为组合且自适应能力是可行的，两阶段训练策略有效提升了VLM在智能体多模态推理中的性能，且具备良好的工具泛化迁移潜力。

Abstract: Agentic multimodal reasoning extends passive image understanding by allowing VLMs to actively acquire and refine visual evidence through visual tool interactions. Effective visual tool use requires three capabilities: grounding tool calls in visual context, composing tools across multiple steps, and adapting reasoning to tool-returned observations. However, existing approaches largely focus on grounding within fixed tool spaces and rigid invocation patterns, leaving composition and adaptation insufficiently addressed. We present VC-Tooler, which learns visual tool use as a compositional and adaptive capability. To this end, we first build a trajectory bank through a hierarchical synthesis pipeline covering three capability levels: single-tool grounding, multi-tool composition, and diverse tool contexts and interfaces. We then train the model in two stages: a supervised cold start that establishes these capabilities, followed by reinforcement learning that encourages accurate, efficient, and context-aware visual tool use. VC-Tooler achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on both general-purpose and agentic benchmarks, including $95.8\%$ on V* and $35.3\%$ on VTC-Bench, and shows promising transfer under richer tool settings at inference time. Project page: https://w1zheng.github.io/VC-Tooler

</details>


### [245] [GenPrior: Unleashing Text-to-Motion Generative Priors for Zero-Shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02236)
*Jidong Kuang,Hongsong Wang,Jie Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenPrior是首个利用预训练文本到运动（T2M）模型的生成先验来解决零样本骨架动作识别（ZSAR）中语义-运动学鸿沟问题的框架，通过分散门控特征融合将运动学原型和类内离散度注入文本嵌入，并借助生成增强原型精炼高置信度未见样本，在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ZSAR方法依赖从文本派生的原型，这些原型缺乏几何结构和物理约束，导致显著的语义-运动学鸿沟（semantic-kinematic gap），限制了未见类别动作的识别性能。

Method: 提出GenPrior框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 分散门控特征融合（Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion）：从T2M生成的运动序列中提炼运动学原型和类内离散度，通过学习的门控网络自适应地将可靠的结构线索注入文本嵌入，同时抑制合成伪影；(2) 生成原型精炼（Generative Prototype Refinement）：利用生成增强原型作为锚点挖掘高置信度的未见样本，将类原型向真实分布校准。

Result: 在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD三个基准数据集上，GenPrior在零样本和广义零样本设置下均实现了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 通过利用生成式运动先验弥合语义与运动学之间的鸿沟，GenPrior为ZSAR提供了新的解决思路，并验证了生成模型先验在动作识别领域的有效性。

Abstract: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition (ZSAR) aims to recognize unseen action categories by aligning skeleton features with textual semantics. However, existing methods rely on text-derived prototypes that inherently lack geometric structure and physical constraints, resulting in a pronounced \textit{semantic-kinematic gap}. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{GenPrior}, the first framework to exploit generative priors from pre-trained Text-to-Motion (T2M) models for ZSAR. Specifically, we introduce Dispersion-Gated Feature Fusion, which distills kinematic prototypes and intra-class dispersion from generative motion sequences and employs a learned gating network to adaptively inject reliable structural cues into textual embeddings while suppressing synthetic artifacts. Furthermore, we propose Generative Prototype Refinement, which leverages these generation-enhanced prototypes as anchors to mine high-confidence unseen samples, calibrating class prototypes toward the true distribution and thereby unleashing strong performance gains. Extensive experiments on NTU-60, NTU-120, and PKU-MMD demonstrate that GenPrior achieves state-of-the-art performance under both zero-shot and generalized zero-shot settings. Code is available at https://github.com/jidongkuang/GenPrior.

</details>


### [246] [HarMoE: Multi-Source Chest Radiograph Pretraining with Dataset-Disentangled Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02252)
*Haozhe Luo,Ziyu Zhou,Shelley Zixin Shu,Mauricio Reyes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HarMoE，一种数据集感知的混合专家框架，用于胸部X射线视觉语言模型的多源异构数据集学习。通过将源特定变异限制在轻量残差专家中，并在统一疾病词汇下进行掩码多数据集监督训练，HarMoE在零样本分类、分布外迁移和grounding任务上优于强基线，证明超越单一图像-报告对齐、转向异构数据集的结构化知识构建是构建稳健放射学VLM的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的胸部X射线VLM主要依赖MIMIC-CXR的图像-报告对齐预训练，但忽略了多标签分类数据集这一更清洁、更显式的疾病监督来源。然而，不同数据集的标签本体、标注协议、采集流程的差异会导致模型将临床语义与数据集身份纠缠，阻碍迁移性能。因此需要一种能够融合多源异构标签数据集的方法。

Method: 提出HarMoE框架：(1) 采用数据集感知的混合专家（MoE）体系结构，共享跨数据集医学语义，同时将源特定变异隔离在解码器深层的轻量残差专家中；(2) 在统一疾病词汇下使用掩码多数据集监督进行训练，利用各数据集的互补标注而避免引入假阴性。

Result: 在大规模胸部X射线基准上，HarMoE在零样本分类、分布外迁移和grounding任务上一致优于强基线。此外构建并发布873k的协调数据集。

Conclusion: 构建稳健的放射学VLM需要超越单一来源的图像-报告对齐范式，转向从具有更清洁监督和更广泛覆盖的异构数据集中进行结构化知识构建。

Abstract: Recent vision-language models for chest X-ray understanding are largely built on image-report alignment and therefore rely heavily on MIMIC-CXR as the dominant pretraining source. While effective at scale, this paradigm underexplores an important alternative source of supervision: a range of existing multi-label classification datasets, which provide cleaner and more explicit disease signals than free-text reports, and can offer broader pathology coverage when combined across sources. However, learning from such heterogeneous datasets is nontrivial, as differences in label ontologies, annotation protocols, acquisition pipelines, and report styles can cause models to entangle clinical semantics with dataset identity, leading to poor transfer despite increased scale. In this work, we revisit radiology VLM construction from the perspective of harmonized multi-source learning. We propose HarMoE, a dataset-aware mixture-of-experts framework that learns shared cross-dataset medical semantics while confining source-specific variation to lightweight residual experts in deeper decoder layers. To further exploit clean supervision from labeled datasets, we train in a unified disease vocabulary with masked multi-dataset supervision, enabling the model to leverage complementary annotations without introducing false negatives. Experiments on large-scale chest X-ray benchmarks show that HarMoE consistently improves zero-shot classification, out-of-distribution transfer, and grounding over strong baselines. Our results suggest that building robust radiology VLMs requires moving beyond single-source image-report alignment toward structured knowledge construction from heterogeneous datasets with cleaner supervision and broader coverage. Code and the 873k harmonized dataset will be released at https://github.com/Roypic/harmoe.

</details>


### [247] [Open-Set Visual Text Forensics via Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02258)
*Jiangling Zhang,Shuxuan Gao,Zeyu Chen,Yichao Liu,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生成式模型的视觉文本篡改检测方法SC-RF，通过估计局部修复代价而非学习伪造决策边界来定位篡改区域，在三个基准上达到SOTA性能，并展现出优异的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有判别式取证模型对特定伪造模式过拟合，难以泛化到未见过的开放式攻击。需要一种不依赖特定伪造模式的学习方式，通过通用统计对齐来实现检测。

Method: 提出稀疏约束整流流(SC-RF)，一种面向检测器的Flow Matching适配用于空间稀疏异常定位；通过自监督伪影注入缓解数据稀缺；使用像素空间的Forensic-DiT保留高频取证痕迹。

Result: 在三个基准上达到SOTA性能，F1和IoU分别超越第二名3.2和4.8个百分点；在未见过的文本编辑模式上展现出强零样本性能。

Conclusion: 生成式检测方法能有效替代判别式方法，通过估计局部修复代价实现对开放集篡改的鲁棒检测，同时模型产生的局部协调可削弱现有检测器的统计线索，为漏洞分析提供新视角。

Abstract: Rapidly evolving Generative AI enables sophisticated visual text manipulations that increasingly evade current forensic detectors. Existing discriminative models often overfit specific forgery patterns, limiting their generalization to unseen, open-set attacks. To address this challenge, we propose a generative detector that localizes tampering by estimating the local restoration cost required to align a query image with authentic visual-text statistics, rather than by learning forgery-specific decision boundaries. Specifically, we introduce Sparse-Constraint Rectified Flow (SC-RF), a detector-oriented adaptation of Flow Matching for spatially sparse anomaly localization. We further mitigate data scarcity via self-supervised Artifact Injection and preserve high-frequency forensic traces using a pixel-space Forensic-DiT. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing the runner-up by 3.2 and 4.8 percentage points in F1 and IoU, respectively. In particular, the proposed detector demonstrates strong zero-shot performance on challenging unseen text editing patterns. We further provide an auxiliary stress-test analysis showing that local harmonization produced by our model can weaken the statistical cues relied upon by existing detectors, offering a complementary vulnerability-analysis perspective.

</details>


### [248] [EOVSAM: Efficient Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with SAM 3 in One Pass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02284)
*Haomin Peng,Yongkang Li,Zhaoxiang Liu,Xiaojie Jin,Shiguo Lian,Yunchao Wei,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EOVSAM框架，将SAM 3从穷举式词汇遍历的高开销范式改造为单次前馈预测的高效开词汇分割模型，通过移除提示条件化并引入注意力聚合策略，实现高达338倍的推理加速，同时保持甚至提升分割精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM 3虽支持名词短语引导的分割并取得有竞争力的开词汇性能，但需通过穷举词汇遍历实现，随着目标类别规模增大，计算开销呈灾难性增长。现有方法依赖多阶段流水线和后处理启发式，效率低下。

Method: EOVSAM包含两大核心设计：(1) 移除prompt conditioning，将SAM 3转化为高效的mask生成器，实现单次前馈预测；(2) 提出Attentional Aggregation策略，以端到端方式优化开词汇分类，避免直接分类优化导致的闭集坍缩（closed-set collapse）问题。

Result: 在所有评测数据集上，EOVSAM相比vanilla SAM 3均提升分割精度，推理速度最高加速338倍。在低分辨率下仍保持高精度且推理速度更优。在标准语义分割和全景分割基准上，EOVSAM达到了有竞争力或SOTA的精度，同时相比现有开词汇分割模型具有显著的推理速度优势。

Conclusion: EOVSAM证明了通过去除prompt条件化和引入注意力聚合策略，可以在不牺牲精度的情况下将SAM 3转化为高效的单次前馈开词汇分割框架，在精度与速度之间取得了优越的平衡，为开词汇分割提供了更实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary segmentation identifies and segments objects from arbitrary textual descriptions. SAM 3 supports noun-phrase-guided segmentation and achieves competitive open-vocabulary performance through exhaustive vocabulary traversal, yet suffers from prohibitive computational overhead as target categories scale. In this paper, we propose an Efficient Open-Vocabulary segmentation framework with SAM 3 (EOVSAM), which adapts SAM 3 for single-pass prediction. EOVSAM removes prompt conditioning to turn SAM 3 into an efficient mask generator and introduces a new Attentional Aggregation strategy to optimize open-vocabulary classification end-to-end. This formulation avoids the multi-stage pipelines and post-processing heuristics commonly used by existing methods, while mitigating the closed-set collapse that can arise when classification is optimized directly. EOVSAM consistently improves segmentation accuracy over vanilla SAM 3 on all evaluated datasets and accelerates inference by up to 338$\times$. Furthermore, EOVSAM maintains high accuracy at lower resolutions while achieving even more remarkable inference speeds. Experiments on standard semantic and panoptic segmentation benchmarks show that EOVSAM combines competitive or state-of-the-art accuracy with a substantial speed advantage over existing open-vocabulary segmentation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/EOVSAM.

</details>


### [249] [Sen-Cap: Sensor-Flexible and Noise-Resilient Human Motion Capture via LiDAR-Camera Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02285)
*Aoru Xue,Yujing Sun,Yiming Ren,Kwok-Yan Lam,Mao Ye,Yuexin Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Sen-Cap是一个传感器灵活且抗噪声的3D人体运动捕捉框架，融合LiDAR和相机多模态数据。它通过统一跨传感器运动估计器在人体中心空间中重建局部姿态和形状，无需传感器间标定，并支持灵活数量的传感器；同时通过迭代细化的抗噪声轨迹追踪器在严重点云噪声下保持鲁棒性。在Human-M3和FreeMotion上达到SOTA性能，并在LiDARHuman26M和RELI11D上展现强跨域性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态人体运动捕捉方法面临两大核心挑战：(1)多传感器对齐/匹配依赖显式标定，在视角变化时传播误差，且限制传感器部署为固定、高度重叠的布局；(2)在真实环境中常见的严重噪声或部分传感器故障下性能显著退化。

Method: Sen-Cap包含两个核心组件：1) 统一跨传感器运动估计器（Unified Across-Sensor Motion Estimator），在人体中心空间中重建局部姿态和形状，无需传感器间标定，支持灵活数量的传感器；2) 抗噪声轨迹追踪器（Noise-Resistant Trajectory Tracker），通过迭代细化在严重点云噪声下保持鲁棒性。
